interface.signature: def check(N: int, M: int, Edges: List[List[int]]) -> bool:

preconditions.expression: 1 <= N <= 10 and 1 <= M <= 15 and all(len(edge) == 2 for edge in Edges) and all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for edge in Edges for u, v in [edge])
preconditions.description: N is the number of vertices (1 ≤ N ≤ 10), M is the number of edges (1 ≤ M ≤ 15), and each edge is a pair of distinct vertices (1 ≤ u, v ≤ N).

preconditions.expression: all(u != v for edge in Edges for u, v in [edge])
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices (no self-loops).

postconditions.expression: return_value == any(all(vertex in path for vertex in range(1, N + 1)) and all((path[i], path[i + 1]) in [(u, v), (v, u)] for i in range(len(path) - 1)) for path in permutations(range(1, N + 1)) if all((u, v) in Edges or (v, u) in Edges for u, v in zip(path, path[1:]))))
postconditions.description: The function returns true if and only if there exists a permutation of vertices (path) such that every consecutive pair of vertices in the path is connected by an edge in the graph (undirected), and the path includes all vertices exactly once (Hamiltonian path).
